USCIS 的 N-400 页面写明：一般申请人要做永久居民满 5 年；与美国公: The USCIS N-400 page says most applicants need 5 years as a permanent resident; if you are married to a U.S. citizen, 3 years, with further conditions on when your spouse became a citizen, the marriage and living together, not just the wedding date. You must be 18 or older; the military and other special cases have their own routes.
绿卡年限之外，还要看连续居住、实际在美国的天数、在递交辖区的居住时间和良好道德品: Beyond the green-card years there is continuous residence, days physically in the U.S., residence in the district where you file and good moral character. List every departure and return; one long trip or many short ones can affect continuous residence. If your history is complex, see a qualified legal service first.

按当前 N-400 要求整理每次出境与返美日期；保留可以佐证的旅行记录。: List every departure and return as the current N-400 asks; keep travel records that back them up.
有婚姻、子女、税务、兵役登记或司法记录相关问题时，按说明书准备真实材料。: Prepare accurate documents required by the instructions for marriage, children, taxes, Selective Service or court-record questions.
曾被逮捕、收到法院文件、长期离境或资料前后不一致的，先问合资格的法律服务再填表。: If you were ever arrested, received court papers, spent long periods abroad or have records that don't match, ask a qualified legal service before filling in the form.

保留完整提交副本、收据与官方通知，并记录每份通知上的回应期限。: Keep a complete submission copy, receipts and official notices, and record each response deadline.
第三步：先确认考试版本，长者例外也有条件: Step 3: confirm the test version and conditions for age-based exceptions
考哪一版，看 N-400 的递交日期。USCIS 写明：2025 年 10 月: Your N-400 filing date decides the version. USCIS says anyone who files on or after October 20, 2025 takes the 2025 civics test: 20 oral questions from a list of 128, pass with 12 correct, fail with 9 wrong. Anyone who filed earlier takes the 2008 test: up to 10 questions from a list of 100, pass with 6 correct. For answers about current officials, check USCIS for updates before the interview.
USCIS 长者说明列出：递交时年满 50 岁且做永久居民满 20 年，或年满: USCIS's note for older applicants lists: age 50 with 20 years as a permanent resident, or age 55 with 15 years, at filing are exempt from the English requirement but still take the civics test; age 65 with 20 years gets special consideration on the civics test. Age and years must both be met; interpreter and medical exceptions have their own official rules.
